IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight brown hair stands against a pale
gray seamless backdrop. She wears a
sheer black long-sleeve mesh top with a
keyhole neckline and small black rose
appliqués, layered over a black bralette.
Below, a red mini skirt with a rose
appliqué and a small embroidered logo.
Tall black buckled biker boots complete
the look. Her expression is calm and
direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of
black, red, and pale gray. Bold and
sleek, in the style of a minimal
streetwear catalog.
